concept.title: Configure the Storage-Based Remediation Operator
concept.shortdesc: You can use the Storage-Based Remediation (SBR) Operator, with the Node Health Check Operator, to create the StorageBasedRemediationConfig Custom Resource (CR). This CR defines the remediation strategy for the nodes.

conbody.p: The StorageBasedRemediationConfig CR resembles the following YAML file:
conbody.codeblock: apiVersion: storage-based-remediation.medik8s.io/v1alpha1 kind: StorageBasedRemediationConfig metadata: name: storagebasedremediationconfig-test namespace: openshift-workload-availability spec: sharedStorageClass: ocs-storagecluster-cephfs watchdogPath: /dev/watchdog nodeSelector: node-role.kubernetes.io/worker: "" sbrTimeoutSeconds: 30 maxConsecutiveFailures: 7 detectOnlyMode: Enabled

ul.li: sharedStorageClass: Displays the name of a StorageClass to use for creating shared storage. When specified, the controller will create a PVC using this StorageClass and mount it in the agent DaemonSet for cross-node coordination, slot assignment, and shared configuration data. The StorageClass must support ReadWriteMany (RWX) access mode. The sharedStorageClass must be specified for the SBR Operator to function.
watchdogPath: Displays the path to the watchdog device on the host. The default path is /dev/watchdog.
nodeSelector: Allows users to control which nodes the SBR agent runs on by specifying node labels. If not specified, the default is for worker nodes only node-role.kubernetes.io/worker: "".

sbrTimeoutSeconds: Displays the base timing for failure detection in seconds. The heartbeat is sent every (sbrTimeoutSeconds/2) seconds. A node is considered unhealthy after maxConsecutiveFailures missed heartbeats. The default is 30 seconds and the permitted range is 10-300 seconds.

maxConsecutiveFailures: Displays the maximum number of consecutive failures (SBR device, watchdog, or local heartbeat writes) before the agent treats the node as failed, and performs self-fencing (when not in detect-only or otherwise disarmed). If not specified, DefaultMaxConsecutiveFailures is used at runtime with a default of 7 failures.

detectOnlyMode: Displays the detection mode. When set to Enabled all remediation is disabled, that is, the agent disarms the watchdog and there is no reboot and the controller does not write fence messages.
